name: inspira-lens

frames.best_why: Frame 5 shows the circular lens clearly enlarging the peaks against the normal-scale photo.

tagline: A round magnifier follows the pointer and enlarges part of the photo.
summary: A wrapper that adds a circular magnifying lens over its child. Moving the pointer drags the zoomed circle around; leaving the image makes it fade away.
appearance: A wide mountain landscape sits inside a rounded rectangle. Under the cursor a circular patch shows the same scene at twice the size, with a soft translucent rim, while the rest stays at normal scale.
behaviour: Moving the pointer across the image carries the magnified circle with it. It fades and shrinks in on entry, then fades out when the pointer leaves the frame.
demo_content: A mountain range above a sea of clouds at sunrise.
use_when: Product, map or artwork detail needs a closer look without opening a lightbox.
avoid_when: It duplicates the child content for the zoom, so it suits one image, not heavy interactive children.
customise: zoomFactor, lensSize and position are props, plus isStatic, hovering and onHoverUpdate to drive it externally; children supply the content.
weight_why: One extra scaled copy of the children and a short enter animation.

a11y.note: The magnifier is pointer-only, so keyboard users get no zoom, and the lens ignores reduced-motion.

issues: Frames 1, 3 and 6 show no lens at all, so the effect appears in only half the clip.
polish_why: Convincing loupe with a smooth fade; the effect is absent in half the frames.
title: Lens Magnifier
